cost_summary:
2026-10-10查核：官方內頁正文已變更；未明列適用年度者為現行參考，116-1最終條件與甄選名額仍待確認。
FAQ International Students
(must read!)
Preparatory German course
: Before the semester begins, you will have the opportunity to participate in an intensive German course. Language courses are conducted by the TUDIAS language school. You can find information about course offers, dates, times, and fees on the homepage of
TUDIAS
.
VISA application information
(Question 8)
Cost of Living per Month (in EUR): Approx. 900 EUR
Additional fees: Semester fee, approx. 350 EUR per semester. All regularly enrolled students must pay a nominal "student payment" that covers the Studentenwerk, the Studentenschaft, and the so-called "Semester Ticket" (this semester ticket serves as transportation pass for busses, trains, trams, S-Bahn/Metro, and rental bike service in and around the greater Dresden area and as Deutschlandticket, i.e. for all basic public transport in Germany).
官方連結：https://tu-dresden.de/studium/vor-dem-studium/internationales/informationen-von-a-z；https://tudias.de/en/；https://tu-dresden.de/studium/vor-dem-studium/internationales/austauschprogramme#section-3
housing_summary:
【住宿資訊】
Not guaranteed, but students can apply for housing. Please note that it is not TU Dresden offering accommodation but
the Studentenwerk
.
Cost of Accommodation per Month (in EUR): 230 – 500 EUR
